title: Sector × country type
statement: The ROA differences between sectors depend on the type of country.
effect_unit: extra adjusted R² from sector × type interactions
p_method: permutation of type labels across countries
notes: Primary: sector × type interaction F = 6.20, extra adjusted R² = +0.0145, permutation p = 0.2075 (4 types, 34 countries).
Largest departures (pp ROA, vs sector and type averages): Energy / type 1 -2.1, Consumer Defensive / type 4 +1.9.
Not replicable on ESEF (no sector field).
